scope: Penultimate Java gate: conservative Spring framework semantics

acceptance.controller_entry: explicit Spring controller plus mapping produces framework/inferred/l0; callers remains empty; impact includes the owner
acceptance.mvc_taint: explicit request-bound MVC parameter is a scan-mode source with exact annotation provenance
acceptance.typed_injection: declared repository method resolves through the typed receiver; undeclared generated method remains possible/dangling
acceptance.bean_entry: Bean in an explicit Configuration is framework wiring
acceptance.callback_entry: event/transactional-event/scheduled method in an explicit Spring component is framework wiring; Async alone is not
acceptance.overloads: the annotated declaration is selected by file and exact span, not ambiguous FQN
acceptance.freshness: removing framework annotations removes the edge through read-repair

negative_oracles: same-named non-Spring annotations create no wiring and no taint source
mapping on an unmanaged class creates no entry
EventListener on an unmanaged class creates no entry
Async without EventListener or Scheduled creates no entry
unmapped helper parameter is not a scan-mode source
undeclared Spring Data derived method is not fabricated
known_boundaries: Spring Data generated method bodies and targets
remaining_java_gate: Pinned clean portfolio of at least four repositories covering Maven, Gradle, multi-module and Spring with setup-build-index-refine-doctor manifests and sampled precision
claim_boundary: This proves the named local Spring contracts. It is not whole-Spring, whole-JVM, universal SAST or CodeQL superiority evidence.
